name: Conductor
description: Interactive orchestral conducting experience in the browser

history.summary: Live visual instrument orchestra (eggs per MIDI track) & dynamic sustained note holding across tempo changes
details: Mapped SVG musician 'eggs' to distinct orchestra sections (Violin I, Violin II, Viola, Cello) with section labels
Animated live note playing reactions: musicians and sections light up with a warm radiant glow when notes on their track play
Fixed sustained notes cutting off during tempo changes by decoupling voice GainNodes from static durations
Supported rubato / held notes: voices sustain indefinitely until their true score beat arrives, allowing expressively slow or fast tempo changes
Added baton swing animation to conductor podium in rhythm with conducted pulse

history.summary: Resume from paused beat, true note duration scheduling, phase-locked transport, soundfont preloading, version modal
details: Enabled resume from current score beat after pausing (two preparatory taps resume from where left off)
Fixed note-off scheduling by passing beat-accurate duration to WebAudioFont wave tables
Preloaded WebAudioFont instrument banks during initial loading screen
Added phase-correction synchronization to ScoreTransport to prevent conductor-orchestra phase drift
Added stopAllNotes() to AudioEngine to silence voices cleanly on pause/stop
Created versioning system and interactive version info modal
Phase 0: PLL-inspired ConductorClock and KeyboardBeatInput with synthetic tap acceptance test suite
Phase 1: MIDI score parsing into beat space (Eine Kleine Nachtmusik), look-ahead Scheduler, WebAudioFont AudioEngine, stage visual and DebugOverlay
